lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model C: proportional and algebraic models

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: A data set is 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The mean is 20. What is the mean absolute deviation?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 8 by 2 by 6 units has a volume of 16 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 96 cubic units, not 16.
No; the volume is 17 cubic units, not 16.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 18 cubic units, not 16.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $10 base fee plus $4 per hour. A customer's total bill was $70. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 24 m, then descends another 17 m, then ascends 19 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 58 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $680 rate will decrease by 5%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 3 ft long, 9 ft wide, and 7 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 0, 20, 40, 60, 80. The mean is 40. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 5 by 6 by 2 units has a volume of 30 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 32 cubic units, not 30.
No; the volume is 60 cubic units, not 30.
Yes; the volume is 30 cubic units.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $15 base fee plus $5 per hour. A customer's total bill was $30. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?
